# Armorial

> Deterministic local search and policy-aware rendering of existing IconPark SVGs for humans and Agents.

Armorial is appropriate when a task needs an existing IconPark asset, an
explicit project icon policy, deterministic SVG output, compact alternatives,
or an explicit human visual choice. It is not a logo or illustration generator,
an arbitrary SVG editor, or an automatic design-approval system.

## Start here

- [Task fit, selection, visual sharing, and installation](./agent-selection.html)
- [Plain-text Markdown representation of the task guide](./agent-selection.txt)
- [Interactive local-first workbench](./)
